seo.title: Landscaping Services in Greater Victoria | RNC
seo.description: Grounds maintenance, landscape installation, irrigation and tree and vegetation management for homes, stratas and businesses in Greater Victoria.

lede: Four services from one local contractor and one point of contact.

sections.heading: Why one contractor helps
body: When maintenance, irrigation and tree work come from one contractor, a broken sprinkler or a leaning tree is more likely to be noticed and flagged, not passed between trades.
